settings.subtext: A method is only as credible as the person who stands behind it. I put my name on every result the system produces — here's why that means something.

settings.lead: I started I Win My Way because I was tired of watching athletes get generic programs, vague rehab and empty motivation — and pay for it with their progress and their careers.

settings.text: Over six years I've worked with hundreds of athletes, from juniors chasing their first dunk to professionals protecting a career. Every one of them taught me the same lesson: the body responds to a system, not a slogan. So I built one — the Athlete Engineering Method — and I've spent every season since refining it against real results.

My obsession is detail. The right assessment, the right load, the right progression, verified by testing. When you control the process that tightly, the outcome stops being a gamble. That's why I can put a guarantee on it — and why I'm in the gym, on the track and in your messages, not hiding behind a PDF.

settings.quote: The goal isn't to be a trainer. It's to build the place elite athletes come to get engineered — and to make that same system available to the kid with a hoop in the driveway.
